vsl: You can be interested in buying a home and still have no idea what you're supposed to do next. Maybe you've saved listings for months. Maybe you've spoken with a lender and now you're wondering how the home search actually works.
The starting point changes depending on what you've already done. That's what this sheet is for.
I'm Evan Karwowski with WR Properties. I made the First Home Next Steps Sheet to help you turn the big idea of buying into a few things you can actually work on.

Start in the first section and mark what's already happened. Have you talked about a working budget? Picked areas you want to explore? Written down the features that would make a move worthwhile? You can leave anything blank that you're still figuring out.

Then choose the question that's holding things up. Suppose it's the money needed to get started. Your next action could be preparing a few specific questions for a lender about costs and the information they need. The lender answers the financing questions. The sheet helps you get ready for that conversation.

Or maybe you've already had that conversation, and now you need to decide which homes are worth seeing. In that case, defining the search criteria and understanding representation may be more useful next steps.
You can download the sheet below and fill it out yourself. If you want help putting the steps in order, book a free 20 minute First Home Game Plan session with me.

We'll start with what you've done and the question you brought. We'll choose up to three next actions, identify who can help, and agree which one comes first. Your written recap arrives within two business days after we speak.

If the next step is an active home search, we can also discuss how I'd help you as your agent, the services involved, and the representation terms. Tell me about any existing agent relationship before we begin.

You can use the sheet even if buying is still a little way off. If you’d like to work through your next steps together, choose Book My First Home Game Plan. Answer a few short questions so I can prepare for our call.
